It sounds incredibly scary and frustrating to know your boyfriend is in the hospital but be unable to get any answers. Please know that hospitals have strict privacy laws which prevent them from sharing medical information with anyone who isn't listed as an official emergency contact or spouse. This silence isn't a reflection of your relationship; it is simply a legal protocol the staff must strictly follow. 

While you wait, try reaching out to his immediate family members or whoever might be his designated emergency contact, as the hospital will likely communicate with them. If your boyfriend is conscious and has his phone, you might also be able to ask him to give the staff verbal permission to speak with you. Waiting for news is exhausting and anxiety-inducing, so please try to lean on your own friends or family for support and remember to take care of your own basic needs while you navigate this difficult uncertainty.
